# ACE v0.3 Overall Goal & Active Scientific Research Roadmap

## Overall North-Star Goal (Continuous)
Continuously build and expand versioned real-world benchmark datasets in `/workspace/benchmarks/datasets/` (registered in `/workspace/benchmarks/registry.json`) across `v0.1` (`6,639` traces), `v0.2` (`741` traces), `v0.3` (`/workspace/benchmarks/ace_v0_3_live_traces.db`), and the 340-paper corpus, and engineer the cohesive `/workspace/ace_v04/` cognitive architecture package to optimize **Task Accuracy**, **Step Latency ($p_{50}/p_{95}$)**, **KV Prefix Cache Hit Rate ($\ge 95\%$)**, **Cost-of-Pass**, and **Turns per Task** with strict $H_0/H_1$ held-out statistical falsification.
